# iam (iam.origincloudapis.eu)

Guide: <https://docs.origincloud.eu/docs/iam/index.html.md>

- **AuditLogService**: An organization's audit log: a record of each change to who may do what in it, written when the change is made and never changed afterwards.
- **FederatedCredentialService**: Federated credentials: a `WORKLOAD` service account's trust in the OIDC tokens of an identity provider outside Origin Cloud, such as the token GitHub Actions gives every job.
- **PermissionService**: The catalog of permissions, and which of them a caller holds.
- **RoleService**: The catalog of predefined roles.
- **RoleBindingService**: Role bindings: each grants one role to one member, in a whole organization or in one of its projects.
- **ServiceAccountService**: Service accounts: an organization's credentials for software, which authenticate with the OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant and never log in interactively.
- **UserService**: The signed-in user.

## Ask before

These delete something or can't be undone: show the user what will change and wait for their yes.

- `origincloud_iam_federated_credential` destroyed or replaced: deletes for good.
- `origincloud_iam_role_binding` destroyed or replaced: deletes for good.
- `origincloud_iam_service_account` destroyed or replaced: deletes for good.

## Types

### AuditLogEntry

One recorded change.

- data source `origincloud_iam_audit_log_entry`: one by its name
- data source `origincloud_iam_audit_log_entries`: every one under a parent

Attributes of `origincloud_iam_audit_log_entry`:

| Name | Mode | About |
|---|---|---|
| `action` | computed | What was done, as a permission key names it, such as `iam.role.assign`. |
| `actor` | computed | Who made the change, as it was when the change was made: `user:{email}` with the verified address the account had then, `userId:{user}` when none was recorded, `serviceAccount:{service_account}`, or `platform` for a change the platform made itself. |
| `details` | computed | Details of the change that depend on the action, such as the `role` granted or a service account's `display_name`. |
| `name` | required | The entry's resource name. |
| `occur_time` | computed | When the change was made. |
| `outcome` | computed | Whether the change was made. |
| `project` | computed | The project the change was limited to, `projects/{project}`; empty for a change to the whole organization. |
| `target` | computed | What it was done to, written as `actor` is, or the email address invited; empty when the action has no target. |

### FederatedCredential

A `WORKLOAD` service account's trust in an identity provider's OIDC tokens that carry the given claims.

- resource `origincloud_iam_federated_credential`
- data source `origincloud_iam_federated_credentials`: every one under a parent
- import by `name`:

  ```hcl
  import {
    to = origincloud_iam_federated_credential.this
    id = "organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}/federatedCredentials/{federated_credential}"
  }
  ```

Arguments and attributes of `origincloud_iam_federated_credential`:

| Name | Mode | About |
|---|---|---|
| `audience` | optional, computed, replaces | The audience a token must be issued for, its `aud`, matched exactly; `https://sts.origincloudapis.eu` when the create leaves it empty. |
| `conditions` | required, replaces | The claims a token must carry, each with exactly this value, such as `repository_id` and `environment` for GitHub Actions. |
| `create_time` | computed | When the federated credential was created. |
| `creator` | computed | Who created the federated credential, written as a role binding's member is. |
| `delete_time` | computed | When the federated credential was deleted; unset while it is active. |
| `display_name` | required, replaces | A name of your own, shown in the console; at most 100 characters. |
| `id` | computed | The federated credential's resource name, the same as `name`. |
| `issuer` | required, replaces | The identity provider whose tokens are trusted: a token's `iss`, matched exactly, an `https` URL that serves `/.well-known/openid-configuration`, such as `https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com`. |
| `name` | computed | The federated credential's resource name. |
| `organization` | required, replaces | The organization the federated credential is in. |
| `service_account` | required, replaces | The service account the federated credential is in. |
| `state` | computed | Where the federated credential is in its lifecycle. |

### Permission

One action on one kind of resource, which a role grants.

- data source `origincloud_iam_permission`: one by its name
- data source `origincloud_iam_permissions`: every one under a parent

Attributes of `origincloud_iam_permission`:

| Name | Mode | About |
|---|---|---|
| `action` | computed | The action it allows, such as `create`. |
| `name` | required | The permission's resource name, `permissions/{service}.{resource}.{action}`, such as `permissions/pvs.volume.create`. |
| `resource_type` | computed | The kind of resource it applies to, such as `volume`. |
| `service` | computed | The service whose API checks it, such as `pvs`. |
| `urn` | computed | The permission's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |

### Role

A predefined role: a named set of permissions that a role binding grants.

- data source `origincloud_iam_role`: one by its name
- data source `origincloud_iam_roles`: every one under a parent

Attributes of `origincloud_iam_role`:

| Name | Mode | About |
|---|---|---|
| `description` | computed | What holding the role allows, in a sentence. |
| `display_name` | computed | The name the console shows, such as `Owner`. |
| `included_permissions` | computed | The permissions the role grants, `permissions/{permission}`, in catalog order. |
| `name` | required | The role's resource name, such as `roles/owner`, `roles/viewer` or `roles/billing.administrator`. |
| `urn` | computed | The role's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |

### RoleBinding

One role granted to one member, organization-wide or in one project.

- resource `origincloud_iam_role_binding`
- data source `origincloud_iam_role_bindings`: every one under a parent
- import by `name`:

  ```hcl
  import {
    to = origincloud_iam_role_binding.this
    id = "organizations/{organization}/roleBindings/{role_binding}"
  }
  ```

Arguments and attributes of `origincloud_iam_role_binding`:

| Name | Mode | About |
|---|---|---|
| `create_time` | computed | When the binding was created. |
| `creator` | computed | Who created the binding, written as a member is, or `platform` for a binding the platform made itself. |
| `id` | computed | The role binding's resource name, the same as `name`. |
| `member` | required, replaces | Who holds the role: `user:{email}` or `serviceAccount:{service_account}`. |
| `name` | computed | The binding's resource name. |
| `organization` | required, replaces | The organization the role binding is in. |
| `project` | optional, computed, replaces | The project the binding is limited to, `projects/{project}`, one of the organization's. |
| `role` | required, replaces | The role granted, `roles/{role}`. |
| `urn` | computed | The binding's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |

### ServiceAccount

A credential of an organization for software.

- resource `origincloud_iam_service_account`
- data source `origincloud_iam_service_accounts`: every one under a parent
- import by `name`:

  ```hcl
  import {
    to = origincloud_iam_service_account.this
    id = "organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}"
  }
  ```

Arguments and attributes of `origincloud_iam_service_account`:

| Name | Mode | About |
|---|---|---|
| `client_id` | computed | The OAuth 2.0 client id it authenticates with; empty for a `WORKLOAD` service account. |
| `client_secret` | computed, sensitive | The OAuth 2.0 client secret it authenticates with. |
| `create_time` | computed | When the service account was created. |
| `creator` | computed | Who created the service account, written as a role binding's member is. |
| `delete_time` | computed | When the service account was deleted; unset while it is active. |
| `display_name` | required, replaces | A name of your own, shown in the console; at most 100 characters. |
| `id` | computed | The service account's resource name, the same as `name`. |
| `member` | computed | The member a role binding names it by, `serviceAccount:{service_account}`. |
| `name` | computed | The service account's resource name. |
| `organization` | required, replaces | The organization the service account is in. |
| `state` | computed | Where the service account is in its lifecycle. |
| `type` | optional, computed, replaces | How the service account authenticates; `EXTERNAL` when the create leaves it unset. |

### User

A person who signs in to the platform.

- data source `origincloud_iam_user`: one by its name

Attributes of `origincloud_iam_user`:

| Name | Mode | About |
|---|---|---|
| `email` | computed | The email address the user signs in with. |
| `email_verified` | computed | Whether the user has confirmed `email`. |
| `family_name` | computed | The user's family name; empty when they haven't set one. |
| `given_name` | computed | The user's given name; empty when they haven't set one. |
| `member` | computed | How a role binding shows the user: `user:{email}` once `email` is verified, `userId:{user}` until then. |
| `name` | required | The user's resource name, `users/{user}`, with their id; never `users/me`. |

## Other actions

These methods aren't a resource's create, read, update or delete. Where an argument of a resource above sets the same thing (a resource's `protected`, say), change the argument; otherwise the provider doesn't manage the action: run it with the CLI, outside of Terraform, when the user asks for it.

- `TestIamPermissions` (`origin iam test-iam-permissions`): Returns the subset of `permissions` the caller holds on an organization or a project.
- `RotateServiceAccountSecret` (`origin iam rotate-service-account-secret`): Issues a new client secret for an `EXTERNAL` service account and returns the service account with it in `client_secret`, the only place it is ever shown.
